title: 5e-11: orient + health MCP tools
description:
## Parent

sutra/83 (5e PRD: health metrics + similarity system)

## What to build

Health context in orient briefings and a dedicated health MCP tool.

- Orient integration: when an agent orients on a file, include health findings for that file (active findings with severity, biomarker kind, detail). Include component instability (Martin's Ce/(Ca+Ce)) as context for the component the file belongs to.
- sutra_health MCP tool: query per-file or per-component health. Returns: derived score, active findings with full detail, category breakdown, component instability. Accepts file path or component name.
- Component instability: Ce/(Ca+Ce) where Ce = efferent coupling (outgoing dependencies) and Ca = afferent coupling (incoming dependencies). Computed from the existing file adjacency graph at component level.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Orient output includes health findings section for the target file
- [ ] Orient includes component instability for the file's component
- [ ] sutra_health MCP tool with file and component query modes
- [ ] Returns derived score, active findings, category breakdown
- [ ] Component instability (Ce/(Ca+Ce)) computed and surfaced
- [ ] Coverage gradient finding included when coverage data is available (silent when absent)

## Blocked by

- sutra/85 (5e-2: health scoring)
- sutra/92 (5e-review-2: checkpoint 2 quality gate)"

Orient health section injected per component showing health_score, top 5 findings, and instability. sutra_file_health extended with component filter arg and instability in component scores. 7 new integration tests (63 total in health-test.rs). Coverage gradient AC satisfied by existing stub (silent when absent).
